I2V-Reuse-R1-01.title: No 「Settings applied」 toast after Reuse
I2V-Reuse-R1-01.short: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Image_to_Video: No 「Settings applied」 toast when Reuse opens the Custom page
I2V-Reuse-R1-01.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Photos
3. Tap My Artwork
4. Tap the All categories button
5. Tap Image to Video
6. Tap a finished Custom video made with Kling 2.6 (10s, Pro, Sound on)
7. Tap Reuse
8. Watch the Custom page for 8 seconds
9. Check the result

Result:
The Custom page opens with the video's settings and prompt, but the toast 「Settings applied」 never shows.
摘要：Reuse 進入 Custom 頁設定已帶入，但沒有出現「Settings applied」toast。
{20.19.0_ir01_reuse_room_no_toast.jpg} {20.19.0_ir01_recording_frames_no_toast.jpg} {20.19.0_ir01_start_end_room_no_toast.jpg} {20.19.0_ir01_log.txt}

Expect Result:
On entering the Custom page the toast 「Settings applied」 shows (PM D1-04).
摘要：進入 Custom 頁時應顯示 toast「Settings applied」。

Note:
Device: Google Pixel 8a / Android 16, Test Server, Free account (build 20.19.0.v202611181947)
Spec Link: Image to Video Reuse PM Figma (page 26'11/E support to reuse model settings in My artwork), Spec - UI board (From Save & Share Reuse, D1-04 / D1-04b toast 「Settings applied」) -

I2V-Reuse-R1-01.qa_note: R-025 / R-026 (PM Spec - UI, From Save & Share Reuse D1-04 / D1-04b: entering the reused Custom page shows the toast 「Settings applied」). Reuse fills the room correctly (model, Start/End, prompt, empty photo; TC-010 / TC-013 / TC-012 Pass), but no toast: screenshots at ~0.6 s and ~2.6 s, a 9 s recording at 2 fps (TC-010), an 8 s recording (TC-015) and waitfor 「Settings applied」 7 s (TC-010, TC-013) found none. Seen on video A (Kling 2.6) and video C (Kling 3.0, Start/End). Blocks TC-016 (toast over a panel) and TC-046. The PM drew the toast only; no Design frame for it (PM-only).
